name: Beelzemon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] Trash the top 4 cards of your deck.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When a card is trashed from your deck, gain 1 memory for every 10 cards in your trash.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When a card is trashed from your deck, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
